summary: Join our pension regulatory frameworks and compliance training course to gain vital knowledge and skills for navigating the complexities of the industry.
lede: Pension regulatory compliance training covers the frameworks and controls used to govern pension funds. It is for administrators, trustees, compliance and risk officers, and others who manage or supervise pension schemes. Learners explore fiduciary responsibilities, governance and investment controls, then apply risk management, compliance monitoring, internal audits, reporting and disclosure practices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across both public and private pension systems who are responsible for managing, regulating, or supervising pension funds, including:
audience: Policy analysts and consultants in pension governance
modules: Understanding Pension Systems and Regulatory Frameworks
Legal and Policy Foundations of Pension Regulation
Licensing, Registration, and Supervision of Pension Entities
Emerging Trends and Global Best Practices in Pension Regulation
